items: Masle ki gunjaish chhoti ho, to har mumkina hal bana kar jaanchna mumkin ho.
Hal dhoondne ki koi saaf hikmat-e-amli na ho, to mukammal talash (exhaustive search) zaroori ho.
Heuristics ya qawaid banaye jane wale hal kam kar sakein, jis se amal zyada kaarkard ho.

blocks.prompt: 3 hindson wala lock code 000 se 999 tak aazma kar mil sakta hai. Generate and test is masle ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Gunjaish chhoti hai (1000 umeedwar) aur har ek jaanchna aasan hai, to sab aazmana mumkin hai; heuristic, jaise pehle zyada imkan wale codes aazmana, ise tez kar sakta hai. Yeh misal wazahat ke liye hai, kitab se nahi.

items: Generate and test tab istemal karein jab gunjaish chhoti ho, behtar hikmat-e-amli na ho, ya heuristics umeedwar kam kar sakein.
